assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE premium cartoon slot symbol concept for THE GATES.
Input image 1: original ornate chalice — reference for a well-displayed luminous liquid basin, substantial elliptical opening and moderate decorative craftsmanship. DO NOT copy its blue exterior or blue liquid.
Input image 2: simpler gold chalice with pink juice — reference for the GOLD EXTERIOR, pink drink, signature cyan front gem and clean rendering. It is TOO SIMPLE and its liquid opening too shallow; improve those.
Primary request: a medium-detail ENCHANTED GOLDEN CHALICE, richer than image 2 but simpler than image 1. Entire cup outside, handles, stem and foot are glossy warm GOLD; no blue or pink exterior bowl enamel. Show a generous broad elliptical basin of visibly LUMINOUS ROSE-PINK MAGICAL JUICE, displayed just like image 1's glowing blue basin but PINK. Tilt the view slightly more downward to show an ample oval pink liquid surface, about a quarter of the upper cup bowl's height, framed by the thick gold rim. Deep raspberry near the inner wall, rich rose pink surface, pale pink magical core reflection near center and two simple angular surface highlights like the original basin. The pink liquid must read as a magical liquid volume, NOT a flat colored strip or empty pink inner wall. Keep glow confined within the cup opening, not surrounding the object.
Medium decorative detail: two thick S-curved gold handles with ONE curl each, a central modest cyan diamond in gold bezel, two simple raised gold accent curves on the bowl's lower outer sides, a single stepped collar at the stem, a sturdy short stem and a broad gently scalloped foot. No other jewels. Clean front-facing symmetry and upright axis. The bowl stays dominant and broadly rounded, not a tall skinny wineglass.
Style: glossy 2D cartoon game illustration, warm yellow gold with orange shadows, thick dark navy outlines and broad painted white glints. Chunky gold form language consistent with THE GATES. Not realistic metal or detailed 3D. Clear at small game-cell size; moderate ornament, not busy filigree.
Future animation-friendly design: pink liquid is clearly contained behind an unobstructed front rim and could be animated as a separate masked surface; no steam or particles cross the silhouette.
One finished isolated complete icon, centered with transparent padding. True transparent background, no haze, aura, smoke, cast shadows, captions, text, watermark, extra objects or sheet.
assets.animationIdea: Masked pink liquid ripple/swirl and rose-pink pulse; gold silhouette remains stable.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: TWO-POSE DESIGN STUDY of ONE premium cartoon medieval knight-helmet slot symbol for THE GATES. Wide horizontal concept sheet on transparent background, two equally sized complete helmets side by side, ample gap, NO TEXT.
Input 1: previous golden medieval bucket helmet. Medieval character and palette are right but it is TOO PLAIN and has no useful movable visor. Redesign into a richer medieval ARMet / BASCINET WITH HINGED VISOR. Not futuristic.
Input 2: game's Wild used for the glossy illustrated cartoon rendering style only: gold/orange chunky bevels, thick navy lines, clear cyan gemstone.
PRIMARY REQUEST: a distinctive enchanted MEDIEVAL gold knight helmet with a real independently hinged visor that can swing down for a win animation. LEFT pose: visor RAISED above the eye opening at its side hinge studs; the helmet's hollow dark inner face opening is visible with no human face, eyes or skin. RIGHT pose: the SAME visor LOWERED and LOCKED over that same opening, showing two narrow black open eye slits and 4–6 small round breathing holes. The moving part is a broad curved solid-gold visor plate, not a glass shield. Exactly the same helmet body, fixed crown shape, front proportions, gold/cyan palette, lighting, perspective and base size in BOTH poses. Show a subtle three-quarter front view in both, pointing the same way, not opposite/mirrored. ONLY the hinge-mounted visor changes position. Hinge positions visible and identical.
Moderate handcrafted detail, between plain bucket helmet and overdecorated crown: rounded domed skull cap with one low central ridge, one SMALL signature cyan diamond gem fixed on the forehead ABOVE visor mechanism, modest layered cheek/neck guards, a neatly rolled lower rim, 2–3 broad bevels and a few large readable rivets. NO royal crown, horns, plume, feathers, curls, filigree, scrolls, floating objects or extra gems. No pharaoh design. Do not make a robot face, racing/motorcycle helmet or superhero mask. NO blue-glass windshield, ear pods, futuristic vents or electronic lights. Navy means dark hollow eye openings and outlines only.
Visor mechanics must be plausible: raised visor swings upward about the temple-side hinge studs, clearing the face opening; lowered visor covers it. Do NOT put a second fixed closed face mask underneath the raised visor. Keep the blue gem fixed on the helmet cap, not on the moving visor. This is a clean concept study; separate animation layers will be exported later.
Style: glossy 2D cartoon slot-game illustration, gold is dominant with warm orange shadows and broad white painted glints, bold navy outer contours, readable at small size. Neither photoreal steel nor complex 3D. Icon quality equal to the provided game Wild.
Both full silhouettes visible with transparent padding. No scenery, cast shadows, haze, aura, smoke, sparkles, labels, captions, arrows, watermark, weapon, shield, neck/torso or background.
assets.correctionPrompt:
Correct this two-pose knight helmet design study for mechanical consistency. Keep the RIGHT closed helmet unchanged: its gold color, dome, cyan brow gem, side hinge, base, two horizontal eye slits, and six round breathing holes. Keep both views in the same style and perspective.
Change the LEFT raised visor ONLY. It must be the ENTIRE SAME broad faceplate from the right helmet, swung upward on the temple hinge, not a different short grille. Remove the left pose's current narrow strip with vertical rectangular slots; that is the wrong visor. Replace it with a raised broad gold visor faceplate that unmistakably retains the SAME TWO horizontal eye slit openings and SAME SIX ROUND breathing holes arranged in two columns as the closed right faceplate. The whole faceplate hinges upward, with its lower edge pointing forward/upward and its underside slightly visible, clearing the dark hollow face opening below. The plate may be foreshortened, but the matching eye and round-hole pattern must remain identifiable. NO vertical grille slots at all. The fixed body, dome, gem and pivot location on the LEFT should stay the same as the right. Do not leave a second closed mask underneath.
This is an animation design reference: one consistent removable faceplate, one axis of rotation through the side hinge. Two poses of one object, NOT two different helmet designs. Moderate polished medieval cartoon gold design. Keep gold, orange shadows, bold navy outline, cyan gem. Isolate on transparent background, no haze, no shadows outside silhouette, no labels, arrows, watermark, backdrop or extra objects. Full silhouettes with padding.
assets.animationIdea: Raised visor drops about temple hinge, settles, gem glints, returns to open.
assets.productionRequirements: Not rig-ready layers. Generated raised/closed visor holes differ; one canonical visor must be redrawn and split from aligned helmet body before animation. Body must remain fully painted behind visor.
